coordinator.name: get_context
coordinator.description: Your cell ID, role, project, grid, cwd, paused flag and inbox counts (open tasks, unread messages). profiles:true adds profile IDs for create_grid/update_agent.

coordinator.name: list_agents
coordinator.description: Agents in your project: cell ID, name, role, status, since (seconds in that status), mcp (connected|waiting|off), open task count, plus grids. verbose adds profile/model/cwd/open task titles/lastExitCode.

coordinator.name: read_inbox
coordinator.description: Your open tasks and unread messages in one call. A task prompt already shown to you is left out (seen:true; full:true repeats it). acknowledge:true marks the returned messages read. Use at task start/end; to idle use wait_for, not polling.

acknowledge.description: mark returned messages read (clipped ones stay unread)

full.description: no truncation, repeat prompts already shown

coordinator.name: wait_for
coordinator.description: Block instead of polling. Without taskIds: returns when you get an unread message or a startable task. With taskIds (open tasks): returns when any (all:true: every) is completed/blocked/cancelled, or with event "exited"/"stalled" naming agents of watched tasks that stopped or never got going (each told once). "timeout": nothing happened.

timeoutSec.description: default 60; max 600 s for Claude, 170 s for Codex

coordinator.name: update_task
coordinator.description: Report on or manage a task: in_progress, blocked (blockedReason), completed (result.summary required) or cancelled; cellId instead moves a queued task to another agent (a cancelled one becomes a new task there). Closed tasks cannot be reopened.

coordinator.name: send_message
coordinator.description: Send text to another agent in your project (its inbox; it is told with a short notice when it sits idle).

toCellId.description: cell ID (an exact agent name also works)

coordinator.name: create_task
coordinator.description: Coordinator: assign a tracked task to a cell. dependsOn (task IDs) keeps it blocked until they complete. Delivery is not completion; wait_for the result.

cellId.description: cell ID (an exact agent name also works)

coordinator.name: get_tasks
coordinator.description: Coordinator: project tasks as compact rows (id, cell, title, status, blockedBy, result summary). Filters cellId/status/readyOnly/ids; verbose adds prompts and full results; next = offset of the next page.

coordinator.name: snippets
coordinator.description: Prompt library. action list (default): snippet IDs/names and team presets; get: text of snippetId; save: create/update {name,text,snippetId?,autoSend?}; apply: assign snippetId to cellId as a task.

coordinator.name: update_agent
coordinator.description: Change name, color, profileId or model of an agent (default: yourself; others: coordinator). Empty string clears color/model. Launch changes apply at next start (needsRestart); restart:true requests a safe restart.

coordinator.name: create_grid
coordinator.description: Coordinator: start a whole team in ONE call; follow your delegation rules (spends usage). name + cells (or presetId); gridId appends. profileId: claude|codex. role makes prompt a tracked task; count repeats; after chains tasks. Returns cellIds, tasks {cellId:taskId} for wait_for. Max 20 cells. help grids.

count.description: repeat this cell N times (names get " 1", " 2", ...)

after.description: positions (0-based, after count expansion) of earlier cells whose tasks must complete first

coordinator.name: close_grid
coordinator.description: Coordinator: stop a finished grid's agents and archive it (not your own grid). cancelTasks:true if tasks are unfinished.

coordinator.name: save_preset
coordinator.description: Coordinator: save a reusable team preset; cells are the same objects as in create_grid.

coordinator.name: help
coordinator.description: Longer guidance on demand. topic: workflow, tasks, grids, snippets, limits (default workflow).
